snippet.title: runz - Official 1.0 trailer
snippet.description:
runz is a game where every bullet in your magazine matters. Survive as the waves get harder, and master an original upgrade system. Build synergies, combine bullets, manage your economy and upgrade your gun in this twin-stick shooter with auto-battler elements.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4704420/runz/
